description_en: Updates the configuration for stream pulling. You can modify the start and end times of origin server addresses in an existing stream pulling task
description_zh: 更新拉流信息，修改已经添加的拉流任务中的源站地址的开始时间和结束时间
kebab_example: aliyun vs update-vs-pull-stream-info-config --domain-name example.aliyundoc.com --app-name xxxApp --stream-name xxxStream --source-url up.xxx.com.cn --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateVsPullStreamInfoConfig

parameters.help_en: The name of the application to which the live stream belongs
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the live stream
parameters.name: stream_name

parameters.help_en:
The origin server of your live stream.

Supports multiple values, separated by English semicolons (;)
parameters.help_zh:
用户的直播流所在的源站。
支持多个，用英文分号（;）分隔
parameters.name: source_url

parameters.help_en:
The start time of stream pulling.

UTC time format. The interval between StartTime and EndTime must be within 7 days
parameters.help_zh:
拉流开始时间。
UTC时间格式，StartTime和EndTime时间间隔在7天内
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time of stream pulling.

UTC time format. The interval between StartTime and EndTime must be within 7 days, and EndTime must be later than the current time
parameters.help_zh:
拉流结束时间。
UTC时间格式，StartTime和EndTime时间间隔在7天内，且EndTime必须超过当前时间
parameters.name: end_time
